headline: Second-Pillar Study: Residents Spent Half of the Withdrawn Money on Consumption - Verslo žinios
summary: Only 14% of Lithuanian residents believe the state pension alone will be sufficient, and the share not saving additionally for old age has grown sharply since the reform.
why: Second-pillar pension funds are mandatory private savings schemes, and withdrawal rules affect household savings and long-term pension asset flows.
